ev .set ROM_SIZE, 0; createmon 0, 0, SPECIES_MAGMAR, 100, abilityNum=0; createmon 0, 1, SPECIES_ESPEON, 100, abilityNum=0; createmon 0, 2, SPECIES_ROSELIA, 100, abilityNum=0; createmon 0, 3, SPECIES_CELEBI, 100, abilityNum=0; createmon 0, 4, SPECIES_MASQUERAIN, 100, abilityNum=0; createmon 0, 5, SPECIES_CARRACOSTA, 100, abilityNum=0; special CalculatePlayerPartyCount; end
include _sn_party_open.txt
snap A2_party
include _sn_party_to_summary.txt
snap A2_s0_info
sumkey DOWN
snap A2_s1_info
sumkey DOWN
snap A2_s2_info
sumkey DOWN
snap A2_s3_info
sumkey DOWN
snap A2_s4_info
sumkey DOWN
snap A2_s5_info
include ../../scripts/r2_summary_info_page_variants/_sum_close.txt
ev .set ROM_SIZE, 0; createmon 0, 0, SPECIES_MASQUERAIN, 100, abilityNum=0; end
evstart .set ROM_SIZE, 0; setwildbattle SPECIES_CARRACOSTA, 5; createmon 1, 0, SPECIES_CARRACOSTA, 5, abilityNum=0; dowildbattle; end
waitbattle
bwalk A2_b1_bt input:HandleInputChooseAction
snap A2_b1_bt_action

bwalk A2_b1_run free
ev .set ROM_SIZE, 0; createmon 0, 0, SPECIES_MAGMAR, 100, abilityNum=0; end
